CROSS-REFERENCE — supporting data for the bound raise, from the 2026-08-12 alarm sweep (full text: session log cosey-vinegarish-mouflon (d0d8-9dfe-f2d8-4364) entry 3; originally mis-filed as childsafe-bizarre-lorikeet comment 12).

All four Aug-12 review-interrupt firings cleared the deferral bound by a hair: deferred_for 1810s / 1820s / 1810s / 1930s against bound=1800s — i.e. 10s, 20s, 10s and 130s over. Every one was a review that finished (or would have) shortly after the deferral budget expired, so raising DEPLOY_DEFER_MAX to 2x the review cap as this ticket did plausibly prevents all four. Firing rate context: ~0.55/day across Aug 1-11 versus 4 firings on Aug 12 alone during the 60+-merge landing burst — the interrupts scale with landing volume, which is exactly the regime the raise targets.
